ovr.basic_enable_desc: Allow invoking the screenshot frame in SteamVR for OCR translation.

ovr.basic_wrist_desc: Shrink translation results and pin them to your wrist position.

ovr.desktop_tts_desc: Read translated results aloud after each scan.
ovr.desktop_osc_desc: Send translated results to the VRChat chatbox over OSC.

ovr.playspace_height_desc: Toggle a character height offset for small avatars or seated floating positions.
ovr.playspace_offsets_desc: Adjust the current playspace position on the horizontal, vertical, and depth axes.
ovr.chaperone_visibility_desc: Adjust boundary grid opacity. A value of 0 hides the boundary.
ovr.chaperone_force_bounds_desc: Keep the boundary grid visible regardless of distance.
ovr.chaperone_haptics_desc: Vibrate controllers when they approach the boundary.
ovr.video_supersampling_desc: Override the global resolution scale. Higher values improve clarity but use significantly more GPU resources.
ovr.util_media_keys_desc: Allows controlling media player via OVR binds.
ovr.steamvr_disable_notifs_desc: Hide SteamVR popup notifications to avoid breaking immersion.
ovr.steamvr_require_hmd_desc: SteamVR requires an HMD to be present to run.
ovr.steamvr_system_button_desc: Allow the system button to be bound and used in any app.

ovr.steamvr_no_fade_grid_desc: Do not show the grid fade-in transition when an app stops responding.
ovr.steamvr_camera_bounds_desc: Automatically show the camera view when approaching or leaving the boundary.
ovr.steamvr_camera_controller_desc: Show a camera overlay above the controller.
ovr.steamvr_per_app_binds_desc: Use different button binding configurations for different apps.

ovr.chap_fade_distance_desc: Set how far from the boundary before it appears (0 = never visible).
ovr.chap_height_desc: Set the display height of the boundary.
ovr.chap_center_marker_desc: Show a position marker at the center of the play space.

ovr.chap_audio_warning_desc: Play an alert sound when approaching the boundary.

ovr.space_adjust_chap_desc: Move chaperone along with the space offset.
ovr.space_seated_recenter_desc: Apply the current headset position and orientation as the seated center.
ovr.motion_drag_desc: Move the play space by dragging a controller; requires binding a button via the SteamVR input system.
ovr.motion_drag_comfort_desc: Limit the movement update rate to reduce motion sickness. Higher values feel more snappy.
ovr.motion_height_toggle_desc: Toggle between zero and offset for quick sit/stand switching.
ovr.motion_gravity_desc: Apply gravity and momentum simulation to play space offsets.
ovr.rotation_auto_turn_desc: Automatically rotate the play space near walls so your view is parallel to them.
ovr.rotation_redirected_walk_desc: Add a tiny rotation while walking to keep you away from the nearest wall, making the space feel larger.
ovr.rotation_view_ratchet_desc: Amplify world rotation based on head turning amount.
ovr.rotation_space_turn_desc: Rotate the play space by rotating a controller.
ovr.rotation_snap_turn_desc: Instantly rotate by a preset angle. Angles that divide evenly into 360° work best.
ovr.spacefix_floor_desc: Place one controller on the ground, then click this button to calibrate floor height.
ovr.spacefix_recenter_desc: Fix floor height while recentering the space around the grounded controller.
ovr.spacefix_apply_offsets_desc: ⚠ Caution: This overwrites the original zero coordinates.
ovr.spacefix_revert_desc: Restore the boundary configuration to its state when VR started.
ovr.audio_playback_desc: Select the VR audio playback output device.
ovr.audio_mirror_desc: Mirror VR audio to another device (e.g., speakers) at the same time.
ovr.audio_prox_sensor_desc: Automatically mute microphone when headset is taken off.
ovr.audio_ptm_desc: Reverse PTT: audio passes by default and mutes while the button is held (PTT must be enabled first).
ovr.video_color_desc: Adjust the picture tint via RGB gain (supports Valve Index / Vive series).
ovr.video_ss_desc: Adjust the render resolution multiplier for apps (refresh the dashboard or restart SteamVR to apply).
ovr.video_profiles_desc: Save and quickly switch between display setting combinations.
ovr.video_adv_ss_filter_desc: Texture filtering that improves distant texture quality (enabled by default).
ovr.video_overlay_color_desc: Adjust color via an overlay instead of gain (compatible with all HMD models).
ovr.util_keyboard_desc: Send simulated keystrokes to apps that need physical keyboard input. Useful for 2D apps without VR keyboard support.
ovr.util_alarm_desc: Set an alarm to show up in VR.
ovr.util_media_desc: Control music playback via media keys. Works with most common players.
ovr.util_tracker_battery_desc: Show battery percentage instead of icon.
ovr.settings_autostart_desc: When enabled, this app runs automatically each time SteamVR starts.
ovr.settings_universe_rotation_desc: Rotate around the universe center instead of the HMD (disables offset auto-compensation).
ovr.settings_crash_recovery_desc: Automatically apply the last boundary configuration after an abnormal shutdown.
ovr.settings_version_check_desc: Disable the startup version check (manual checks still available).
ovr.settings_force_steamvr_chap_desc: Third-party headsets also use the native SteamVR boundary system.
ovr.settings_auto_chap_profile_desc: Automatically load a specified boundary configuration on each startup.
ovr.settings_force_disable_oculus_desc: Force SteamVR/Oculus cross-platform games to run via SteamVR only.
ovr.settings_exclusive_input_desc: When active, only OVRAS or app keys are sent (system keys always work).
ovr.settings_disable_vsync_desc: Customize the base refresh rate (for very high or low refresh-rate headsets).
ovr.settings_shutdown_ovras_desc: Close Advanced Settings without leaving VR.
